dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Lyylikki, how have things gone for you lately?

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Ah! Hello, Lady Lauma. Everything's been going smoothly here.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: The supply of ingredients has been steady, no one's causing trouble, and my cooking skills have really improved!

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Oh, by the way, about those "friends" you mentioned last time... Were you talking about those animals?

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: They're so well-behaved and just quietly watch the people in line. I tried offering them something to eat, but they wouldn't take it...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Those little ones understand their duties. When they're on shift, they stay focused and hold to their posts.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Still, once they're off duty, feel free to give them a little treat. Hehe, I'm sure they'd be delighted.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Great! Then I'll make something delicious today to show my thanks.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Thank you, Lyylikki. If you need any help, just let me know.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: No need, really! I've got it all under control — and besides, Mr. Kantor and Miss Jahoda are helping out.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Alright, I'll leave you to it. See you later, Lyylikki.

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Ah, I should go bring out the next round of dishes... Oh, Lady Lauma, would you like to try this plate as well? It's freshly made — just came off the stove!

dialogues.speaker: Lyylikki
dialogues.text: Alright, now to plate the food... Huh? Where are the plates I just washed...
